derivedTelemetry.recomputeFunction: recomputePowerNetwork() in lunaSimulationProvider.ts — deterministic, conceptual: MDB energized = ATS has a live source (grid if utility available, generator if actually running); riser/branch/6A meter/6A DB cascade one-for-one off MDB's energized state

triggeredBy: sequenceGeneratorPhase() itself once a phase transition lands
